title: Ten Billion, How Many Megawatts
concept: Interior Secretary Burgum told a Fairbanks Chamber crowd on October 14th that people want to drop ten billion on a data center with no tax breaks, two days after Golden Valley Electric's first alert under its new alert system, a Level 2 with reserve under 15 MW. The film stands a block of money against a growth chart marked in megawatts, shows they are in different units, gives the best case for yes (Ellendale's homes and rebates, a customer that brings its own power) a full scene, and lands on one blank readout: the reports name no megawatts. A glass ReserveBar with a face is the throughline.

fingerprint.palette: frost noon, snowbank, reserve cyan, hazard orange, banknote green, charcoal
fingerprint.light_story: low peach sun over an Interior snow day, a deep navy cutaway, hazard-orange alerts
fingerprint.metaphor: a growth chart marked in megawatts that a block of dollars can't be measured against

palette: frost noon, snowbank, reserve cyan, hazard orange, banknote green, charcoal
divergence_note: 10-16 was a black-spruce night with tungsten and chalk around a seismic station, and 10-15 pearl fog with a cranberry Gate. This film is a bright snow-and-ice winter noon with cyan, hazard orange and banknote green, a tall thin glass gauge against a squat heavy money block, and it moves through a height-chart room, a snowy door, a funnel machine, a remote on a table, a date drum and switchbox, a navy reserve cutaway, a plant yard, a postcard street and a ledger desk.

treatment.winner: The Explainer's balance scale and reserve cutaway, with the Comedian's smug CashBlock, the Dramatist's pause button and the Enthusiast's Ellendale test.
treatment.why: The scale makes the units mismatch a picture before a word is said, the cutaway makes a reserve felt, and the best case for yes gets a full scene that ends on the same blank readout.

angle.thesis: Burgum's ten billion is priced in dollars while Fairbanks' grid is counted in megawatts, and Fairbanks can't say yes or no until someone puts the two on one page.
supporting_facts: c5 to c8: GVEA's first alert under its new system, reserve under 15 MW, one unit offline and two in maintenance
c2, c3, c13: Burgum said ten billion and electricity into intelligence, and the reports name no megawatts
c12: one Cook Inlet filing says 100 MW, not on GVEA's grid, scale only
angle.counterpoint_to_honor: The alert was a supply event, not a data center event, and Burgum's model (Ellendale, N.D., c4) came with homes and bill rebates, and no tax breaks means the investor carries the cost. A big customer that pays for its own power could leave Fairbanks with more reserve, not less. The thesis claims no harm, only that the deciding number is unpublished.
angle.falsifiability: False if a developer, site and megawatt load are published for the ten billion and it brings its own generation, or GVEA states standing headroom for a large load.
angle.second_movement: Rewind the week on one reserve bar, then turn: the best case for yes (Ellendale, no tax breaks, pause then proceed) is a list of terms Fairbanks can ask for, and every term is a megawatt question.
angle.ai_point_OUR_READ: Labelled opinion. Burgum's own sentence turns electricity into intelligence, so the AI question here is a power question first.
angle.valence: Constructive and open, not anti and not boosterish. 'Name the megawatts' is what the evidence earns.

runner_up_angles.A: Enthusiast: what has to be true for Alaska to win (merged as the second movement)
runner_up_angles.B: Dramatist: the porch light household and who pays (merged as the human stake)

angle.debate: Grid-math base kept. Enthusiast's Ellendale terms became the counter-scene. Dramatist's unfair-juxtaposition objection is answered by the thesis claiming no causation. Cold-climate cooling and developer-paid generation are not in the claims and stay out except as questions.

hook.frame1: A smug green money block thuds onto one pan of a brass balance scale while the other pan holds a blank megawatt readout, and the beam refuses to tip.
hook.headline: TEN BILLION, HOW MANY MEGAWATTS
hook.loopback: The last frame is the balance scale again with the bar stepping onto the right pan, the open replaying.

open_loop.what: How many megawatts the ten billion is. Paid as the ask: the reports name none, so name them.

open_loop_2.what: Whether a new big customer could fit beside a reserve under 15 megawatts. Paid as the reports not saying whether this one would bring its own power.
